🔀 Multi-repo context Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts ## Linked repositories findings ### Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts - GTS distributes GMEOW artifacts but explicitly does not depend on GMEOW, so the quality ontology additions have no linked GTS API/dependency consumer to update. [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::README.md:1109-1111] - GTS assigns vocabulary and validation rules to profiles, while requiring profile revisions to preserve baseline parse, verify, and fold semantics. The new quality constraints therefore remain above the transport layer. [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::docs/GTS-GOVERNANCE.md:127-129] [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::docs/GTS-GOVERNANCE.md:147-150] - The RDF model preserves literal lexical values and explicit datatype IRIs; `DatatypeIRI` resolves those datatypes for consumers. This supports transporting typed mathematical values without a GTS wire-format change. [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::go/model/model.go:58-65] [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::go/model/model.go:398-413] - GTS supports appending observations and folding independently produced graph segments, but the repository contains no direct references to the new quality-assessment classes or constraints.
